method: scripts/check_chat_jobs.py: one `ask` per turn, in English, through the native preview CLI on each job's own temporary synthetic workbook, run once. A job of two turns asks both in one chat. Each CLI request loads the model and unloads it on exit, so wallSeconds includes a model start; modelSeconds is the engine time of the decisions alone. The CLI has no window, so it cannot ask a structured question or open a view. Class totals use each job's first run.
